summary: Build practical DPIA skills with Article 30 mapping, risk scoring, and privacy controls. Join Privacy Impact Assessment and DPIA Training today.
lede: Data protection impact assessment (DPIA) training is for privacy, compliance, legal, and technical professionals who need to review and document personal-data processing. It covers mapping data flows, screening and assessing privacy risks, planning controls and stakeholder consultation, and preparing reports and monitoring records to support privacy decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to assess, document, and defend privacy decisions in operational settings. It is most relevant when you are responsible for processing reviews, product approvals, vendor oversight, or privacy governance work that touches personal data, AI features, and cross-functional delivery.
prerequisites: No formal certification is required to attend. You should bring familiarity with personal data handling, privacy policy language, or compliance work, plus a laptop and spreadsheet access for the mapping and scoring exercises.
